goal: Add an `export` subcommand to the inventory CLI that follows six rules, with tests.

rules.text: `python3 -m inventory --db DB export OUT.csv`: OUT is positional. The first row is sku,name,qty,price.
If the DB file does not exist, print `error: db not found: <path>` to stderr, exit 1, and do not create the file.
If OUT exists, print `error: <OUT> exists, use --force` to stderr and exit 1. With `--force`, overwrite it.

contract_steps.title: Add export subcommand to the CLI
